findings.title: Receipt holds are lost on process restart
findings.evidence: Sugar unit u-3a4492884a5e received two signed receipts 436 seconds apart across the 02:35 restart, inside HOLD_SECONDS=600; no double payment established. Local restart probe reproduces release.
findings.fix: Persist per-unit pending receipt reservations, reload on start, and release from confirmed settlement/expiry evidence.

findings.title: Settled exploration units can remain pending forever
findings.evidence: Offline fixture supplies 8 units then provides 8 explicit settlements with no current stock. All 8 remain issued_unknown and reserve 60000 of exposure.
findings.fix: Reconcile intent status from settlement and unit arrival evidence; keep rolling exploration spend recorded while releasing pending unit/cost exposure.

findings.title: Purchase requirements disappear after the opening turn
findings.evidence: Follow-up prompt has no original buyer request or structured min-hours/grade/warranty constraints. Offline deliberately bad model choice can sign a 36-hour food unit despite an 84-hour request. Mixed text is rejected without model interpretation.
findings.fix: Keep compact structured requirements and validate them when selecting and signing; pass changed buyer conditions to the model.

findings.title: Coverage exploration preempts existing replenishment plans
findings.evidence: At 23 stocked SKUs, the fixture has a valid replenishment plan needing 3 units. The coverage branch instead emits 8 new SKU intents without ever executing that plan. This is a policy interaction, not a demonstrated live stockout.
findings.fix: Keep broad seeding, but allocate part of each window budget/slots to existing seller demand. Distinguish initial coverage completion from continually requiring 24 currently stocked SKUs.

findings.title: Seller cannot offer goods warranties
findings.evidence: Decision schema and signed receipts omit warranty_hours. Buyers that require warranty cannot be served, although goods are now purchased.
findings.fix: Expose no-warranty and 6-hour warranty pricing/risk alternatives for model choice; include the selected term in the canonical seller receipt.

validation: Four isolated deterministic probes; fake model, temporary local keys, local A2A only, no market writes.
